description: This Istanbul school-zone study applies the iRAP Star Rating for Schools method to ten schools in the Arnavutköy area. Zenodo lists a publicly accessible Excel workbook of field observations and assessments, but its metadata does not state a licence; reuse rights remain unknown. The provider says inspectors rated road safety around the schools and proposed physical interventions to reduce risk. This is a real-place infrastructure risk assessment that could supply baseline school-zone conditions or intervention options for pedestrian-safety simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this ten-school application. A limitation is that the page does not publish the actual star ratings, traffic exposure, observation dates, design drawings or later crash outcomes; these may be present in the workbook but were not checked. Proposed changes must not be described as built or effective. The named study paper is not independently verified as published. The workbook was not downloaded and no rating was reproduced.
